data.description: HAProxy Technologies builds HAProxy One/HAProxy Enterprise for traffic management, including load balancing, UDP load balancing, and API/AI gateway functions, along with multi-layered security like SSL/TLS termination, DDoS protection and rate limiting, bot management, and web application firewall (WAF). It targets enterprise use cases in multi-cloud and Kubernetes environments, providing management and observability for load balancers and application delivery.
